title: Parse a CSS hex colour into red, green, blue and alpha
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: An anchored case-insensitive pattern admits exactly the four forms, short digits are doubled and alpha uses the brief's formula.
It delivers toHexColor, which formats channel values as a hex string, instead of the parseHexColor parser the brief asks for.
It shifts each short-form digit left by four bits instead of repeating it, so "#f80" gives r 240 and g 128 instead of 255 and 136.
A lookup table validates every digit, short digits expand as 17 times their value and the result has exactly the four keys with the specified alpha.
